name: copilot-deep-research-tool
description: Deep research local-first tool for Copilot Chat with asynchronous report generation.

commands.title: Deep Research: Configure Gemini API Key
Deep Research: Configure Local LLM Model

deepResearch.backend.description: Backend selection policy for deep research execution.

deepResearch.maxSources.description: Maximum number of sources to collect per local research run.

deepResearch.outputFolder.description: Workspace-relative folder where research reports are written.

deepResearch.enableCloudFallback.description: Allow fallback to Gemini cloud backend when local collection fails.

deepResearch.pollIntervalSeconds.description: Polling interval for background job status refresh in seconds.

deepResearch.enableReaderProxy.description: Enable reader proxy enrichment for dynamic pages to improve extract quality.

deepResearch.readerProxyBaseUrl.description: Base URL for optional reader proxy used to fetch cleaner text from complex web pages.

deepResearch.targetDocDomains.description: Preferred documentation domains for targeted docs discovery.

deepResearch.maxDocResultsPerDomain.description: Maximum selected documentation results per configured domain.

deepResearch.requestTimeoutSeconds.description: HTTP request timeout per provider in seconds. Increase on slow networks.

deepResearch.enableVerboseLogging.description: Enable detailed logging for debugging provider calls and performance metrics.

deepResearch.localLlmEnabled.description: Use a local LLM (Ollama) for multi-pass map-reduce synthesis of research findings. Falls back to statistical summary if unavailable.

deepResearch.localLlmEndpoint.description: Ollama API endpoint for local LLM synthesis.

deepResearch.localLlmModel.description: Ollama model name for local synthesis (e.g. mistral:7b, llama3.1:8b, phi3:mini).

deepResearch.localLlmMaxSources.description: Maximum number of sources to feed into local LLM map-reduce synthesis.

languageModelTools.name: run_deep_research
languageModelTools.userDescription: Launches an asynchronous deep research run and writes a markdown report into the workspace.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Use this tool for complex, multi-source research questions that require external references and a structured report. This tool is asynchronous: it starts a background job and returns immediately with a job identifier. Prefer this tool for market scans, API/framework comparison, architecture tradeoff analysis, and broad troubleshooting evidence gathering. Avoid using it for simple factual questions or small code edits.

scope.description: Optional scope hint such as languages, frameworks, vendors, or date range.

preferLocal.description: If true, prefer local backend execution over cloud fallback.
